outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic/micrograph illustrating image cropping and rotation; it is not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel b is a schematic/micrograph illustrating image spacing; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel c is a schematic/micrograph illustrating insets/magnifications; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows micrographs at different brightness/contrast settings with a schematic slider; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic color-annotation examples and micrographs of channel markers; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel f shows schematic overlap diagrams and grayscale micrographs; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars and a schematic gradient legend; this is not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
